stories.title: 11 can kaybının olduğu faciada otobüsün mola görüntüleri ortaya çıktı

en.title: Footage emerges of tour bus stop in disaster that claimed 11 lives
en.summary: A tour bus collided with a truck in Akhisar, Manisa, resulting in 11 deaths and 27 injuries. Video footage of the bus during a rest stop has surfaced.

stories.title: İletişim Başkanı Duran'dan Israel Katz'ın alçak ifadelerine sert tepki! "Siyasi çaresizliğin göstergesi"

en.title: Communications Director Duran responds sharply to Israeli Defense Minister Katz's statements: "Sign of political desperation"
en.summary: Turkey's Communications Director Burhanettin Duran criticized Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz on social media for comments targeting President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, characterizing them as reflecting political desperation.

stories.title: İzleyenlerin bile yüreği ağzına geliyor! Katliam gibi kaza anının görüntüsü ortaya çıktı

en.summary: Video footage of a bus accident in Akhisar, Manisa has emerged, showing the collision that killed 11 people and injured 27 others.

stories.title: Manisa'da feci kaza... 11 kişi hayatını kaybetti: Görüntüleri ortaya çıktı, 3 kişi gözaltında!

en.title: Tragic accident in Manisa... 11 people killed: Footage emerges, 3 people detained
en.summary: A collision between a tour bus and a truck in Akhisar, Manisa resulted in 11 deaths and 26 injuries. Three suspects have been detained during the investigation, and video footage of the accident has surfaced.

en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned an attack by Iran-backed Houthis from Yemen on King Khalid Airport in Saudi Arabia.

en.summary: Flooding caused by overflow of the Budhi Gandaki River in northern Nepal destroyed homes and bridges, prompting evacuations from surrounding villages.
